Question B-005-001-011. Lesson link: L-005-01.

Why the correct answer is right: One millihenry is 1 000 microhenries. 10 000 microhenries divided by 1 000 is 10 mH.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: This is ten times too large.
- sourceIndex 2: This is ten times too small.
- sourceIndex 3: This is one hundred times too large.
